raw.rationale: PKI-179 is a dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor whose antiproliferative activity is largely cytostatic and depends on PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway activation, which is common across many lineages rather than restricted to one; PRISM single-concentration data for such inhibitors typically show broad weak effects with few lineage-selective viabilities. Thus selective lineage killing at the required -0.5 log2 threshold is unlikely for any lineage, with modestly higher chances in PIK3CA/PTEN-altered lineages such as breast, uterus, and central nervous system.
